description: This file defines a Java annotation interface called CommandType used to specify command types in the Fineract project. It includes metadata such as entity and action names related to commands.

classes.name: CommandType
classes.description: An annotation interface used to annotate classes with command type information, including entity and action names.

methods.name: entity
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity associated with the command type.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Returns the name of the action associated with the command type.
